name: heliaCORE
groupsNote: The eight operator families, carried over from GROUP_PATTERNS in docs/_ext/api_group_index.py. The patterns, their order and the group ids are identical to the Sphinx directive, so scripts/check_api_group_classification.py keeps guarding the same vocabulary. Headings, eyebrows and blurbs are the wording already on docs/reference/api-groups.md. A pattern is a JavaScript regular expression tested against the bare function name; a function joins the first group whose patterns match.
